narrative.overview: An Arabic right-to-left memory book that feels like a letter folded into a favorite scrapbook. A flower-sealed envelope frames the first-run password setup and returning-user lock. After authentication, real photos sit beside the owner's actual stories on warm paper. Content remains local in an ignored SQLite database and image folder; the interface does not claim cloud backup or public-hosting security.
keyCharacteristics: Warm textured paper with restrained botanical ink and pressed-flower accents.
A clear password gate framed by a tactile sealed envelope.
A nearby writing form and spacious scrapbook gallery.
Arabic copy, right-to-left flow, visible keyboard focus, and reduced motion.

rules.name: The Keepsake Rule
rules.body: Paper remains the main surface; rose, sage, and honey are small accents.

rules.name: The Private Content Rule
rules.body: Personal text and photo bytes stay behind the authenticated session.

rules.name: The Real Memory Rule
rules.body: Never seed pretend personal content; the owner's actual photos and writing lead.

dos: Do keep photo and memory responses behind authentication.
Do explain that the database and photos are stored locally.
Do keep Arabic, right-to-left layout and readable controls consistent.
Do confirm destructive actions and announce errors.
donts: Don't claim cloud synchronization or public-internet security.
Don't serve uploaded photos from an unprotected static folder.
Don't let the envelope decoration replace a real password form.
Don't invent example memories that might be mistaken for personal content.
